# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_references.py: run `just skill-references` instead of editing. -->

Every command, its arguments and options, as `--help` shows them. Every command also takes `--help`.

## `discogskit`

discogskit: Discogs Data Dumps Toolkit

```text
discogskit [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Options:

- `--version`: Show version and exit.
- `--install-completion`: Install completion for the current shell.
- `--show-completion`: Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.

Commands:

- `convert`: Convert Discogs XML dumps into flat files (Parquet or JSONL).
- `load`: Load Discogs XML dumps into a database.
- `skills`: List or print the bundled agent skills: usage guides matching this version.

## `discogskit convert`

Convert Discogs XML dumps into flat files (Parquet or JSONL).

```text
discogskit convert [OPTIONS] {paths}...
```

Arguments:

- `paths...`: One or more .xml.gz files or directories containing them [required]

Options:

- `--compression <brotli|bzip2|gzip|none|snappy|zstd>`: Compression codec. Parquet: brotli, gzip, snappy, zstd (default), none. JSONL: bzip2, gzip, none (default).
- `--compression-level <int>`: Compression level for codecs that support one: JSONL gzip/bzip2, Parquet brotli/gzip/zstd. Rejected for snappy and none. Default: JSONL gzip uses level 6 (faster, slightly larger output than 9; measured in #32); every other codec uses its own library default.
- `-f, --format <jsonl|parquet>`: Output format [default: parquet]
- `--output <path>`: Output directory [default: .]
- `--chunk-mb <int range>`: Split XML into chunks of roughly this size (MB) [default: 256; x>=1]
- `--parse-workers <int range>`: Number of parallel parse workers [default: (half the CPU count, at least 1); x>=1]
- `--write-queue <int range>`: Chunks parsing may run ahead of writing: at most --parse-workers plus this many chunks are parsing or waiting to be written [default: 2; x>=1]
- `--keep-xml / --no-keep-xml`: Keep decompressed XML file after converting [default: no-keep-xml]
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite`: Overwrite existing output files [default: no-overwrite]
- `--profile / --no-profile`: Print detailed per-table timing breakdown after convert [default: no-profile]
- `--progress / --no-progress`: Show a progress bar instead of per-chunk output [default: progress]
- `--strict / --no-strict`: Fail on unhandled XML elements, after listing them all [default: no-strict]

## `discogskit load`

Load Discogs XML dumps into a database.

```text
discogskit load [OPTIONS] {paths}...
```

Arguments:

- `paths...`: One or more .xml.gz files or directories containing them [required]

Options:

- `--dsn <str>`: Database DSN (e.g., postgresql://localhost/postgres) or path to SQLite file [env var: DATABASE_URL; default: postgresql://localhost/discogskit]
- `--chunk-mb <int range>`: Split XML into chunks of roughly this size (MB) [default: 256; x>=1]
- `--parse-workers <int range>`: Number of parallel parse workers [default: (half the CPU count, at least 1); x>=1]
- `--write-queue <int range>`: Chunks parsing may run ahead of writing: at most --parse-workers plus this many chunks are parsing or waiting to be written [default: 2; x>=1]
- `--fk / --no-fk`: Enforce foreign key constraints (SQLite and PostgreSQL) [default: no-fk]
- `--keep-xml / --no-keep-xml`: Keep decompressed XML file after loading [default: no-keep-xml]
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite`: Overwrite existing tables in the database [default: no-overwrite]
- `--profile / --no-profile`: Print detailed per-table timing breakdown after load [default: no-profile]
- `--progress / --no-progress`: Show a progress bar instead of per-chunk output [default: progress]
- `--strict / --no-strict`: Fail on unhandled XML elements, after listing them all [default: no-strict]

PostgreSQL:

- `--pg-create-schema / --no-pg-create-schema`: Create --pg-schema if it doesn't exist [default: no-pg-create-schema]
- `--pg-index-workers <int range>`: Number of parallel index creation workers [default: 2; x>=1]
- `--pg-schema <str>`: Schema to create tables in (must exist unless --pg-create-schema)
- `--pg-unlogged / --no-pg-unlogged`: Skip WAL for faster writes (tables stay unlogged; data lost on crash) [default: no-pg-unlogged]
- `--pg-write-workers <int range>`: Number of parallel database write workers. Above 1, each table group commits separately, so a failed load can leave part of a chunk in some tables: re-run the whole load with --overwrite [default: 1; x>=1]

## `discogskit skills`

List or print the bundled agent skills: usage guides matching this version.

```text
discogskit skills [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Commands:

- `get`: Print a skill's SKILL.md.
- `list`: List the bundled skills, tagged with the installed version they describe.
- `path`: Print the directory holding the bundled skills, or one skill.

## `discogskit skills get`

Print a skill's SKILL.md.

```text
discogskit skills get [OPTIONS] {name}
```

Arguments:

- `name`: Skill name [required]

Options:

- `--full / --no-full`: Append the skill's references/*.md [default: no-full]

## `discogskit skills list`

List the bundled skills, tagged with the installed version they describe.

```text
discogskit skills list [OPTIONS]
```

## `discogskit skills path`

Print the directory holding the bundled skills, or one skill.

```text
discogskit skills path [OPTIONS] [name]
```

Arguments:

- `name`: Skill name; without it, the directory holding every skill
